player_text: I step back out of the line. This guard will not give me a yes or a no. I walk over to the threadbare figure who has been standing still, watching packs and faces, and I ask quietly what they are waiting for.
visible_motivation: The guard keeps refusing to decide. The still figure from the opening is the other person actually present, and they look like they are waiting for something.
intended_meaning: Leave the guard and ask the threadbare figure what they are waiting for.
